pay.title: Payments & Financial Operations
pay.subtitle: Collect membership fees, verify manual UPI & QR receipts, and manage invoices.
pay.approveConfirmDesc: Approving records a verified financial ledger entry, marks the invoice paid, and immediately restores the member's paid gym access.
pay.rejectDesc: Provide a clear reason for the member (e.g. illegible screenshot, transaction ID mismatch). The invoice will remain unpaid and restricted access will be preserved.
pay.rejectionPlaceholder: E.g. Screenshot unreadable, wrong amount transferred, transaction not found in bank statement.
pay.disclaimer: Notice: Manual approval confirms the evidence inspected. It does not constitute automated bank verification.
memberPay.title: Membership Fee Payment

memberPay.step1: 1. Pay using any UPI app (GPay, PhonePe, Paytm) or Bank Transfer to the gym details below.

memberPay.step3: 3. Take a screenshot or download the receipt PDF and submit it below.

features_section.section_title: Everything your gym needs, built into one platform.
features_section.section_subtitle: Designed from real gym floor workflows to help you save time, reduce missed payments, and give members a seamless experience.
features_section.members_short: Organize member profiles, contact information, and membership records.
features_section.members_long: Keep all member records, medical notes, emergency contacts, and active plans organized in a central, searchable directory. No more spreadsheets or lost paper files.
features_section.members_h2: Instant search by name, phone or member ID
features_section.attendance_short: Record and review member attendance efficiently.
features_section.attendance_long: Fast check-in workflow for front-desk staff or automated turnstiles. Eliminate rush-hour entry bottlenecks and get accurate attendance counts in real time.
features_section.renewals_short: Manage membership plans, expiry dates, and renewal workflows.
features_section.renewals_long: Monitor expiring memberships before they lapse. Automate renewal reminders via WhatsApp and keep retention rates high with customizable plan structures.
features_section.renewals_h1: Flexible daily, monthly and annual plan tiers
features_section.payments_short: Track cash, UPI and card fees with automated receipt generation.
features_section.payments_long: Streamline fee collections, manage partial payments, and issue professional receipts instantly. Keep your financial books clean and audit-ready.
features_section.payments_h1: UPI, card and cash payment logging
features_section.qr_short: Frictionless digital entry passes directly on members' phones.
features_section.qr_long: Provide members with dynamic QR access codes for seamless check-in at front desk or turnstile scanners. Eliminates plastic cards and entry disputes.
features_section.reports_short: Actionable insights into revenue, member growth, and gym operations.
features_section.reports_long: Clear, visual dashboards showing daily revenue collections, member retention trends, and class attendance to help you make informed business decisions.
features_section.reports_h4: CSV and Excel exports for accounting
